entities.name: C5M8M4
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Candida tropicalis methionine aminopeptidase 2 (MetAP2); sequence length 432 aa.
Curated annotation: cotranslationally removes initiator N-terminal methionine from nascent proteins, often when residue 2 is small and uncharged.
EC 3.4.11.18; divalent-metal-dependent metalloaminopeptidase. Candidate active metals include Fe2+, Zn2+, Mn2+, and Co2+; physiological cofactor remains debated.
Catalytic reaction: hydrolytic release of N-terminal amino acids, preferentially methionine, from peptides; overall Met-peptide + H2O → methionine + peptide lacking N-terminal Met.
